Users who rely on ChatGPT for quick image searches can now use a brand-new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recent photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been available for nearly two years, it still only supports newer iPhone models and isn't available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT to perform similar image searches, previously adding a photo required tapping the plus button, then tapping "Photos," and then selecting an image from the album.

Although the process isn't overly complicated, OpenAI added a practical gesture last week that makes adding recent photos quicker.

OpenAI's Adam Fry mentioned on platform X that users can now long-press the plus button on the left side of the prompt box to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can select a photo to add to the conversation, then ask a question or incorporate it into the prompt.

This new gesture, along with several other ChatGPT changes, was rolled out last week, including more accurate awareness of the current time, faster loading and navigation for long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts while waiting for a network connection.

Have you ever used AI for image searches? Feel free to share in the comments.
